title: Coral and the Witness
author: Cyrus Vane
blurb: Ada Ravensworth, a hotel concierge who notices everything, thought they had seen every way a life can end. Then a body turns up dressed in clothes stolen from the witness's own closet — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must decode a ledger hidden in plain sight before the anniversary dinner raises its glass.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
